title: Málaga march against gender-based violence on International Day

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against gender-based violence, citing that Málaga has the highest number of such murders in Andalusia this year.
tea.want: They demand a stronger commitment to protecting women, including stable services, adequate staffing, and increased funding.
tea.changed: Nov 25: The platform Violencia Cero scheduled a march from Plaza de la Merced to Plaza de la Constitución for the evening.

summary: On November 25, 2026, the platform Contra las Violencias Machistas "Violencia Cero" organised a march in Málaga to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. The demonstration, themed "A las violencias machistas no des like," was scheduled to begin at 19:30 at Plaza de la Merced and conclude at Plaza de la Constitución with the reading of a manifesto. Organisers highlighted that seven women have been killed by partners or ex-partners in the province during 2026, the highest figure in Andalusia. The manifesto calls for improved strategies, funding, and staffing to combat gender-based violence, while also denouncing budget cuts and the rise of rhetoric denying the existence of such violence. Public authorities, excluding the Vox party, held separate commemorative events earlier in the day.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The platform Violencia Cero scheduled a march for 19:30 starting at Plaza de la Merced.
